summary: Honor of Kings entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Honor of Kings
entries.definitive_edition: Current iOS/Android global client with region/season documented

emulation.emulator: Android emulator only if supported and compliant with current service rules
emulation.notes: Prefer real iOS/Android hardware and capture via device mirroring.

primary.version: Current Honor of Kings global mobile client
primary.why: Honor of Kings is a mobile-first 5v5 MOBA. The current iOS/Android global client is the practical playable route, while the Chinese 2015 service history should be documented separately from the current region/server state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current iOS or Android client on real hardware. Record app version, region/server, account age, hero/skin unlocks, ranked season, control settings, network conditions, monetization state, and whether any China-region history is only referenced rather than played.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if compliant with current service rules and capture needs.
secondary.why: Real mobile hardware is the baseline because the game is designed for touch/mobile play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record region/server and do not assume China-service history equals the current global build.
